blocks.text: The digital library serves students and staff of the institute.

E-book licensing terms are managed by the procurement office. 2. Functional requirements REQ-1: The system shall allow a member to borrow up to 5 items at the same time. Acceptance criteria: · Borrowing a 6th item shows 'Borrowing limit reached'. REQ-2: The system shall set the loan period to 14 days. Acceptance criteria: · The due date equals the borrow date plus 14 days. REQ-3: The system shall allow one renewal if no other member has reserved the item. Acceptance criteria: · Renewal is refused when a reservation exists. REQ-4: The system shall send a reminder 2 days before the due date. Acceptance criteria: · The reminder is sent by email at 09:00 local time. REQ-5: The system must block borrowing for members with overdue items. Acceptance criteria: · A member with one overdue item cannot borrow.
